adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `currentPage` and `totalPages` compute `Math.floor(... / this.get("limit")) + 1` without guarding against `limit === 0`. The diff also changes `Group#findMembers` to set `limit` from `result.meta.limit`, and `GroupsController#members` derives `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` with no minimum/validation, so a request with `limit=0` will echo `meta.limit: 0` back to the client. That makes these computed values `Infinity`/`NaN`, breaking the page display and `showingLast` comparison.
